feedback: Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is stated for it. The evidence is iteration 7 and iteration 9, which are the same geometry (50 mm span, 12 mm footprint, y 0.05, wheel_track 0.10) and scored 399.7 with oval progress 0.995. Iteration 8 (60 mm span, iteration 3 also at 60 mm) collapsed oval progress to 0.301 and 0.275, so 60 mm is rejected. Bend max_error has stayed on a 0.059 to 0.068 m plateau across every span, footprint, lead, speed, wheel_track and controller change. Line losses stay near 1 per run, so sensing is not losing the tape. The Integrator is lowering kd to 0.33 to bring s-bend steering oscillation (0.317 in iteration 9) under 0.3. Decide from the next race as follows. If oval progress is at or above 0.95 and s-bend oscillation is at or below 0.3, the controller is stable and the y 0.04 lead test on the bend tracks is the next geometry change. If oval progress falls below about 0.95 or bend max_error rises above 0.068 m, the damping change hurt, so the Integrator will restore kd 0.375 before any geometry change. If bend max_error stays on its plateau with the controller stable, the lead test is the next lever.
